title: What to do when a buyer does not pay you
summary: Simple steps to follow up on late payments.

sections.heading: Keep a clear record
paragraphs: Write down each sale on credit: the date, the amount and the customer. A clear record helps when you ask for payment.

sections.heading: Ask politely first
paragraphs: Send a short, polite reminder. The free reminder message tool can write one in English or Hindi.

sections.heading: If you are a micro or small supplier
paragraphs: There is a complaint portal for delayed payments. It is named in the box above.

sections.heading: Get advice for large amounts
paragraphs: For a large amount, get advice from a CA or a lawyer before you take any step.
